# Anchor rename rewriting

When a file rename is observed (source_change_observed change == 'renamed'), anchors' file_path is remapped and the symbol_path prefix is rewritten when the old module prefix matches the anchor's symbol_path.

Preserve symbol-level anchor matching across file renames so identity scores do not drop to zero due to path renames.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/normalize.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.normalize._file_to_module`
